title: Descriptive Writing
titleMy: သရုပ်ဖော် စာရေးသားခြင်း
description: A rich, image-filled paragraph; keep accuracy high while the vocabulary stretches your fingers to new corners.

exercises.instruction: Slow down for the unusual words and glide through the familiar ones.
exercises.text: The sunset turned the sky into a sea of orange and pink. Long shadows stretched across the quiet field. A cool breeze carried the smell of fresh grass while the first little star began to shine.
